posts:
A useful checklist doesn't need to contain every possession you own.

For everyday routines, the most valuable reminders may be the things that are different today. The extra bag, the appointment paperwork, or the item you promised someone you'd bring.

That's the idea behind What Am I Forgetting?, a simple tool for thinking through what you might overlook: https://whatamiforgetting.garrettsdevdesk.com

Sometimes thirty quiet seconds before leaving can save you twenty minutes of turning around later.

You remember the important appointment, pack your bag, and get out the door on time. Then you realize the water bottle, lunch, or paperwork is still sitting exactly where you left it.

What's the one thing you seem to forget most often when you're heading out? I'm curious whether everyone has their own version of the forgotten water bottle.
